card.name: Digit zero before a decimal point
card.fires_on: The digit 0 inside numbers in tables and dose lists, right before a decimal point or more zeros, as in 0.039 or 10,000. Also fires on an opening parenthesis after a dose.

modes.label: Zero in numbers
modes.description: The digit 0 that begins a decimal or sits inside a number like 10,000 in tables or rates.

modes.label: Parenthesis after dose
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after a dose, introducing an alternate volume.

modes.label: Code operator spacing
modes.description: Piece of C++ stream output where the variable name ends and the operator follows.

card.writes: It promotes the symbol < and bracket-like characters, so it predicts punctuation or operators next.
card.plain: It marks the digit 0 in decimals and dose tables, where a decimal point or symbol usually comes next.
